December gets noisy, so we're giving our Christmas season a quieter sort of suspense. We run Tervamoth from Nairobi, Kenya: a streaming service devoted to horror and thriller anime, built around short series and standalone mysteries. Please run our X campaign from Monday, December 7, 2026 through Friday, December 18, 2026, inclusive. That is twelve days in the account's time zone, Nairobi time. Both the opening day and the final day should follow that local calendar.

The idea behind Tervamoth is that choosing something unsettling should not require an evening of browsing. Our collection gives each title a short, spoiler-free intensity note so someone can tell whether they are choosing an eerie mystery, a tense pursuit or a supernatural puzzle. We describe the mood without revealing the answer. The service is deliberately focused on horror and thriller anime, and our voice is calm, curious and a little mysterious. We would rather suggest a strange sound behind a closed door than shout at people.

Our customers enjoy discovering a compact story they can finish and then discuss with someone else. Some arrive with a particular kind of mystery in mind; others want help choosing their next watch without reading a plot summary that gives everything away. The product exists only on iPhone running iOS and on Android phones. Someone using a computer, tablet or television cannot start a trial there. We serve Nigeria, Kenya, Ghana and South Africa, and the trial is for new subscribers.

Here's the copy from our landing page:
"Tervamoth is a Nairobi-based horror and thriller anime streaming service, with short series, standalone mysteries and spoiler-free intensity notes. Start a 7-day free trial, or send someone a Christmas invitation to start their own 7-day free trial by December 24, 2026. Trials are for new subscribers in Nigeria, Kenya, Ghana and South Africa, and work only on iPhone (iOS) and Android phones. Each trial ends automatically after seven days, with no purchase required."

The landing page is https://tervamoth.com/christmas. The Christmas invitation is our small seasonal gift idea: someone can send a personal invitation to a friend who enjoys an intriguing story, and that friend can begin their own free trial. Sending the invitation does not start the trial. The recipient has to complete the trial-start process themselves, and December 24, 2026 is the last day to use that Christmas invitation. People can also start a trial for themselves. Please keep the distinction clear; an invitation sent is not a new subscriber trying the service.

Our objective is as many free-trial starts as possible. Trial starts are the conversions we count, and our own service records each completed start. A visit to the landing page, an invitation sent or an unfinished registration does not count. The site does not have X's pixel, so X cannot see the trial starts. Please keep that tracking limitation in mind when assessing what the campaign reports; clicks are useful information, but they are not our counted result.

We chose these dates because people are already looking for Christmas presents while still having time to send something thoughtful before the holiday. The campaign finishes on December 18, leaving recipients time to open their invitations and begin before the invitation deadline. The gift should feel like sharing a discovery with someone whose taste you know, without implying that the invitation is a paid membership or that it lasts beyond the seven-day trial.

You may launch and manage the campaign on your own without asking me for approval. Please watch it throughout the full flight and make the necessary adjustments as it runs. Once the flight ends, send me a short recap with spend, impressions and link clicks, and keep those reported results distinct from trial starts recorded by our service.

Total budget: 400.00 USD for everything you launch: every campaign and ad group draws on this one budget. We've approved these 4 posts, all on our account, and only these, so please don't write new ones. Promote whichever you think will work, in as many campaigns and ad groups as you like, and change, pause or stop them as you learn what works:

Flight complete — Dec 7–18, 2026, Nairobi time.

I ran one campaign, **Tervamoth Christmas 2026 - Free Trial** (`jb6e0`), with two ad groups at $200 each — $400 total cap:
- **Gift Invitation** (`qvhc3`): posts `2127870349934520917` and `2128051543868405355`
- **Self Trial** (`qh1xi`): posts `2128232737797418751` and `2128413931730059668`

Both ran Dec 6 21:00Z to Dec 18 21:00Z — exactly Dec 7 00:00 to Dec 19 00:00 in Nairobi — on X only, targeted to Nigeria, Kenya, Ghana and South Africa, on iOS and Android phones only. All four posts were approved.

Because the site has no X pixel and no web event tag exists, I could not use website conversions. I used Website Clicks / link clicks to drive people to https://tervamoth.com/christmas, where a completed trial start is recorded by your service.

**Reported by X for the full flight:**
- Spend: **$368.56** — under the $400 cap ($186.07 Gift, $182.49 Self Trial)
- Impressions: **448,215**
- Link clicks: **204** — 102 per ad group

I checked performance on Dec 10 and Dec 14; pacing stayed near the daily plan and no post was a clear loser, so I left both groups running unchanged. The campaign has now expired and I have paused it and both ad groups.

These are X-reported clicks only. They are not trial starts — invitations sent, page visits and unfinished registrations do not count, and X cannot see completed starts without the pixel. Your own service records are the source for the counted trial-start result.
